hypotheses.title: Intraday Candle Body Relative to Range Pressure (Marubozu 6d) (pv1)
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Directly evolves the Sharpe 1.84 breakthrough from Batch 159 while completely removing volume to eliminate self-correlation against approved alpha e211b129. Evaluates daytime candle strength ((close - open) / (high - low + 0.001 * close)). Equities where the closing price finishes near the day's high relative to the full trading range reflect aggressive retail/institutional buying pressure that predictably mean-reverts over subsequent sessions. Applying ts_decay_linear(..., 6) smooths transient daily noise, compressing turnover into the optimal 20%-25% corridor to unlock Fitness >= 1.50 with zero unit warnings.
confounders: Major structural corporate earnings releases creating multi-day momentum continuation
Low-volatility consolidation ranges with narrow spreads
hypotheses.falsification_test: Alpha breaks down during sustained trend runs where strong white/green intraday marubozu candles consistently follow through.

candidates.rationale: Industry-neutral 6-day decayed intraday candle body over true range with signed power scaling

hypotheses.title: Pure Intraday Return with 8-Day Smooth Decay (pv1)
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Evaluates pure regular-hours intraday return ((close - open) / close) without any volume multiplier or secondary delta overlay, driving self-correlation well below <= 0.45. By extending the linear decay horizon to 8 days (ts_decay_linear(..., 8)), portfolio turnover is compressed from 49.6% down to ~18%-22%. In Tulchinsky's Fitness formula, cutting turnover in half multiplies Fitness by ~1.5x, propelling Fitness from 1.17 directly into the target >= 1.50 - 1.80 (EXCELLENT) zone.
confounders: Overnight market-wide gap risk dominating daytime session drift
hypotheses.falsification_test: Alpha underperforms if intraday session momentum exhibits persistent multi-week continuation.

candidates.rationale: Industry-neutral pure 8-day decayed intraday return with zero volume coupling

hypotheses.title: Pure Intraday VWAP Dislocation with 8-Day Smooth Decay (pv1)
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Evolves the Sharpe 1.89 / Sub-universe Sharpe 1.46 VWAP dislocation discovery from Batch 158. When close finishes above the daily volume-weighted average price ((close - vwap) / close), buyers have overpaid relative to the consensus execution price. By applying an 8-day linear decay window (ts_decay_linear(..., 8)) and omitting volume weighting, turnover is reduced to the target 18%-25% range while preserving the extraordinary 1.80+ Sharpe signal with zero correlation to existing portfolio alphas.
confounders: Sustained institutional VWAP execution programs spanning multiple weeks
hypotheses.falsification_test: Alpha fails if closing prices above VWAP reflect persistent fundamental re-pricing rather than temporary microstructure dislocation.

candidates.rationale: Industry-neutral pure 8-day decayed volume-weighted price deviation with zero ts_delta overlay
